description: This file declares function prototypes for small matrix multiplication kernels used in quantized neural network computations within QNNPACK. It defines macros for declaring these kernel functions, which are specialized for different hardware architectures such as Neon and PSIMD.

methods.name: DECLARE_PYTORCH_SGEMM_UKERNEL_FUNCTION
methods.description: Macro to declare a sgemm micro-kernel function with specified name, parameters include matrix dimensions, data pointers, and parameters for clamping.
